nurses-physicians-emts-and-healthcare-le.author: Christopher Perkins, BSN, RN
nurses-physicians-emts-and-healthcare-le.core: Posted in last 7 days Nurses Physicians EMTs & Healthcare Leaders - Human Cost of Healthcare Healthcare workers: I want to hear your story. I’m beginning research for my next nonfiction book, Good in a Crisis, about the human cost of working in healthcare—what the work gives us, what it takes from us, what follows us home, and what needs to change. I’m looking to hear from nurses, physicians, respiratory therapists, CNAs, paramedics/EMTs, therapists, healthcare leaders, and others who have worked in healthcare. I want the whole picture: What brought you into healthcare? What has the work given you? What has it taken from you? What experiences still follow you home? What have we learned to call “normal” that people outside healthcare might find extraordinary? I created an electronic questionnaire so you can share your experience in writing, on your own time. Most questions are optional, deeper topics are optional, and you may participate without providing your name or email address. You also decide whether anything you share may be quoted, paraphrased, attributed to a pseudonym, used anonymously, or used only as background. Please do not include identifiable patient information. Share your experience: https://lnkd.in/g9tWpDQa If you know a healthcare worker whose story deserves to be part of this conversation, please share this with them. Healthcare asks extraordinary things of ordinary human beings. I want to understand what that has meant for the people doing the work. #Healthcare #Nursing #HealthcareWorkers #MentalHealth #HealthcareLeadership

freelancers-in-amsterdam-going-solo-boun.author: Aman Dhami
freelancers-in-amsterdam-going-solo-boun.core: Posted in last 7 days Freelancers in Amsterdam - Going Solo, Boundaries, Invoices, Identity For most of my career, work came with a title, an office, and someone else deciding what came next. Building my own business has changed that. In this edition of Beyond the Headlines, I'm writing about what nobody quite prepares you for when you go out on your own - the freedom, but also the invoices nobody chases but you, the boundaries you have to learn to set, the strange validation of being chosen for you, not the name beneath you. I'm also thinking out loud about whether a career has to belong to one place, and why Amsterdam has been on my mind lately. If you're based there, or know the city well, I'd love to hear from you. Say hello! #BeyondTheHeadlines #freelancing #amsterdam #careergrowth
